customSections.label: What WCSD Families Should Know
customSections.content: Four details on the Balanced Calendar need more context than a date list alone provides.

groups.label: December 17 has two roles
items: Students begin Winter Break on December 17. WCSD also designates that date as a teacher workday. Quarter 2 ends December 16. Students return Tuesday, January 4; January 3 is a no-student professional-development day.

groups.label: Professional-development days
items: Students do not attend October 11, January 3, or February 1. WCSD counts these professional-development dates as school days in session under the note printed on the official calendar.

groups.label: Conference week
items: WCSD marks October 18–22 as conference week, but the calendar does not designate the entire week as a districtwide student holiday. Check the school for appointment and dismissal details.

groups.label: Final contingency days
items: May 31, June 1, and June 2 are scheduled school days on WCSD's Balanced Calendar. June 2 is also the end of Quarter 4 and the last day of school.

whatsNew.title: What Changed from 2026–27
content: School starts August 9, one day earlier than in 2026–27. The last day moves from June 4 to June 2.
Fall Break moves to October 4–8. Quarter 1 ends October 15, followed by conference week October 18–22.
February 1 is added as a no-student professional-development day counted in session; the November professional-development date used in 2026–27 does not appear on this calendar.
Spring Break moves earlier to March 20–31, and the final in-session contingency window becomes May 31–June 2.

calendarFaqs.q: Which WCSD calendar should my student use?
calendarFaqs.a: Most WCSD schools use the Balanced Calendar shown on this page. Students assigned to Gerlach, Incline, or TMCC should use that school's separate official calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: When does WCSD start school in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Students on the Balanced Calendar start Monday, August 9, 2027. Incline starts August 16, while Gerlach and TMCC publish separate schedules.

calendarFaqs.q: When is WCSD Fall Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break on the Balanced Calendar runs October 4–8, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is WCSD Winter Break in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break on the Balanced Calendar runs December 17–31, 2027. January 3 is a no-student professional-development day, and classes resume January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When is WCSD Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break on the Balanced Calendar runs March 20–31, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the WCSD last day in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: The Balanced Calendar ends Friday, June 2, 2028. May 31–June 2 are labeled contingency days in session, not optional vacation days.

calendarFaqs.q: Do students attend school on WCSD's May 31–June 2 contingency days?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. May 31, June 1, and June 2 are scheduled school days on the 2027–28 Balanced Calendar. June 2 is the last day of school.
